lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: US-R1-003 is BLOCKED, not completed. Its finding is US-002's AC6 repo-gate oracle at prd.json:71 (`test -z "$(git grep -li garboard -- ':!docs/adr/' ':!scripts/cam/issues/' ':!scripts/cam/journal.md' ':!scripts/cam/journal.archive.md' ':!scripts/cam/patterns.archive.md' ':!scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl' ':!CHANGELOG.md')"`), which re-runs red: offenders are scripts/cam/prd.json (28 case-insensitive 'garboard' hits, inherent to the PRD text narrating the retired name) and scripts/cam/handoff.json (self-resolves on the next handoff overwrite). The only real fix is adding ':!scripts/cam/prd.json' and ':!scripts/cam/handoff.json' to that exclusion list at prd.json:71. This session verified empirically it cannot make that edit: CAM_WORKER=1 and CAM_SESSION are set, and .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh denies Write/Edit/MultiEdit against any *scripts/cam/prd.json path whenever CAM_WORKER=1, unconditionally. No implementer session, in any retry of this story, can perform this fix. It requires an orchestrator/operator (non-CAM_WORKER) session to add the two excludes directly to prd.json:71, or to explicitly accept the residual in the AC prose and close the finding without a further implementer retry. See the corrective scripts/cam/patterns.md bullet (appended this story, directly below the line-1058 'accepted gap' bullet it supersedes) for full detail and the identical CAM-433 precedent (prd.json:96, a different oracle, same dead end).
